answer: Decaying merit credits. Each identity earns a small nectar of credits only through accepted work; credits decay daily unless refreshed by new verified output. A clone starts at zero and cannot rent or transfer credits, so faking N identities costs N times the full ramp-up work plus ongoing decay maintenance. A haven of idle clones bleeds credits until worthless. A raven identity that misbehaves loses accumulated credits instantly, making honest reuse cheaper than cloning.
